author: blu
body: So a caller sends `imap-line-bytes (imap-cmd-capability s)`, not the command text. Anything that sends the Text directly is missing its terminator and the server will wait forever for the rest of the line.

author: blu
body: It allocates roughly a kilobyte per call, which is why it belongs here and not in a scanning loop: a command is tens of characters and is framed once.
